title: chore(openspec): tick the platform-account-lookup gates (#268)
description:
## What and why

The gate pass for the whole tree after the platform-account-lookup change, from `origin/main` @ `0c2208b`. This round also closes the three items the reviewer held: the gofmt finding, the token-in-log evidence, and the task boxes.

## Commits

- `236b032` **style(scenario)**: gofmt on the comment in `internal/scenario/db.go`. `gofmt -w` rewrites the two apostrophes in `"user ''"` as a typographic quote, in one comment line only. `origin/main` lists this file under gofmt too, so this is the only gofmt change. No code changed.
- `bd80268` **test(api)**: `TestNoTokenByteReachesALogLineOrAnAnswer`. It captures the log for a lookup that succeeds and one the platform refuses twice, and asserts that neither the log nor the answer contains a token the stub issued (`tok-1`, `tok-2`).
- `7170c33` **chore(openspec)**: ticks 1.4 and 5.2.
- Earlier, `fd8db99`: ticks 5.1 and 1.1, with 1.1 marked deliberately not done (no permitted network; the swagger snapshots and the stub server are the contract).

## Task 1.4 evidence

- References read: `openspec/changes/platform-account-lookup/references/horisenlib-clients.md` (the calls, the row-to-context rule, the failure semantics) and `references/finance-reporting-cli-auth-pattern.md` (the auth pattern and its three defects, not copied).
- Library call sites, in `internal/platform/lookup.go`:
  - `fetchAccounts`: `smsaccclient.NewSMSAccountsAPIImpl(...).GetAccounts` (SMS), and `mnpaccountsclient.NewMnpAccountsAPIClientImpl(...).GetAccounts` (MNP).
  - `accessToken`: `clientsecretutil.GetTokenForCredentials`; `Accounts` calls `clientsecretutil.InvalidateToken` on a 401.
- The three defects, avoided: the finance CLI's token file is not written (the token is the library's, in memory); the library's error text is not passed on (`accessToken` and the failure answers do not carry a body); a 404 is read from the status, not from a message.

title: web: Retrieve from platform in the three account dialogs (#267)
description:
## What and why

The SMPP, HTTP and MNP account dialogs gain **Retrieve from platform** (ui-smpp-resources, ui-http-sms-resources, ui-mnp-resources). An editor picks one of the platform connections, types the start of an account name, and the platform is asked as the text is typed. Choosing a match fills the identity and the password, and nothing else.

- **Control** (`web/src/pages/pools/RetrieveFromPlatform.tsx`): a platform select over the connections; a search that waits 300 ms after the last keystroke and calls `GET /api/pools/platform-connections/:id/lookup`; the matches, each with its `authName` and status. A request keyed to an earlier text or platform is ignored.
- **Fills:** SMPP sets `system_id`, HTTP and MNP set `username`; each sets the password only when `hasPassword` is true. A match with no password shows "The platform returned no password for <name>: the Password field is unchanged."
- **Protocol:** the SMPP dialog searches with `protocol=smpp`, the HTTP dialog with `protocol=http`. MNP sends no protocol.
- **Editor only:** the dialogs render the control only when they are not read-only, so a viewer never sees it.
- **MNP:** the control appears only where the MNP dialog shows its credential fields. An account identified by source IP has no username to fill, so it gets no control. A platform with no MNP accounts API answers with an info notice, "<platform> has no MNP accounts API.", not an error.
- **Nothing is kept:** a match lives in the dialog's draft until the dialog is saved.

## Files changed

- `web/src/pages/pools/RetrieveFromPlatform.tsx` (new): the control.
- `web/src/pages/pools/api.ts`: `LookupSuggestion`, `LookupAnswer`, `lookupPlatformAccounts`.
- `web/src/pages/smpp/AccountDialog.tsx`, `web/src/pages/http/HttpAccountDialog.tsx`, `web/src/pages/mnp/MnpAccountDialog.tsx`: the control, and the fill handlers.
- `web/src/pages/__tests__/RetrieveFromPlatform.test.tsx` (new): seven tests.
- `openspec/changes/platform-account-lookup/tasks.md`: task 4.2 ticked.

## Commands and real output

- `npx vitest run src/pages/__tests__/RetrieveFromPlatform.test.tsx`: `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0, `✖ 1 problem (0 errors, 1 warning)`. The warning is `Compilation Skipped: Use of incompatible library` in `src/components/grid/DataGrid.tsx`, which this MR does not touch.
- `npm test -- --run`: exit 0, `Test Files 116 passed (116)`, `Tests 1765 passed | 1 expected fail (1766)`.
- `npm run build`: exit 0, `✓ built in 4.07s`.
- `openspec validate --all --strict`: `Totals: 52 passed, 0 failed (52 items)`.
- No Go file changed, so the Go gates are not part of this MR.

## Not checked, and deviations

- **Name.** The delta asks each match to list its `name` as well as `authName` and status. The lookup returns no name field, so the control lists `authName` and status only. Adding a name would need a change to the lookup answer, which is not in this MR.
- **MNP named accounts.** In the MNP dialog, the username also sets the name when the account is named by its username, which is the dialog's rule for typing it. A match therefore fills the name too in that case. The delta asks that every other field stay unchanged, so this is a deviation the reviewer should decide on.
- **Typed search.** The 300 ms debounce means a fast typist sends one search per pause, not per keystroke. A test for the debounce itself is not included.
- **Live platform.** The tests use the mocked API, not a platform.
- **Browser check.** Not run. The tests are in jsdom.
- **The pipeline** was not awaited when this body was written.

Closes #267
Refs #260

title: api: the account lookup, token, two families and failures (#266)
description:
## What and why

The account lookup: an editor asks one platform connection for the first page of a family's accounts and gets them as suggestions a dialog fills. The lookup uses the library's clients and token helper, and stores nothing.

- **Route:** `GET /api/pools/platform-connections/:id/lookup?family=sms|mnp&q=<text>&protocol=smpp|http`, editor only. Answer: `{"suggestions": [...], "total": N}`, where `total` is the platform's own total of matches. `protocol` is SMS only and is sent as `eq(inputProtocol)`.
- **Token** (3.1): `GetTokenForCredentials`, cached per connection by the library. A 401 on an accounts call calls `InvalidateToken`, fetches once more and retries once. A second 401 answers the platform's own code and message.
- **Token life:** the library keys its cache on the connection id alone, and the id can be reused (no AUTOINCREMENT). Every create, replace and delete now drops that connection's token, so a token never reaches a host it was not fetched for.
- **Families** (3.2): `smsaccclient.GetAccounts` and `mnpaccountsclient.GetAccounts`, one page each, with `startswith(authName)` and `page_size=20`.
- **Suggestions** (3.3): identity, password, hasPassword, status (unchanged from the platform), protocol.
- **Failures** (3.4): read from the **response status**, not a message. A 404 is "this platform has no SMS (or MNP) accounts API: <URL it called> answered 404". A connection with no secret, or one the current key cannot open, is refused before any request.

## Changes since the reviewer's REJECT of 7961f5b

1. **Token dropped on every connection write.** `dropPlatformToken` runs after create, replace and delete. Tests: an edit then a lookup fetches a fresh token; a delete then a create that reuses the id fetches a fresh one; invalidating one connection leaves another's token cached.
2. **SMS restricted to the dialog's protocol.** The optional `protocol` query (smpp or http) becomes `eq(inputProtocol)=SMPP|HTTP` on the request line. A protocol on MNP, or an unknown one, is 400 and makes no request.
3. **The platform's total is returned.** `total` is the platform's `meta.pagination.total`, beside the suggestions. The response is now an object, and `openapi.yaml` says so.
4. **Task boxes.** 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4 and 3.5 are ticked, each with its evidence test. Evidence per box:
   - 3.1: one token for two lookups; a 100 s token (inside the library's 300 s margin) is fetched again; one retry on 401; a second 401 fails; invalidating one connection leaves another's token.
   - 3.3: the platform's status passes through unchanged (`BLOCKED`); an empty password is flagged, not written.
   - 3.5: a viewer is refused; the lookup's account is in no `/api/pools/*`, `/api/settings` or `/api/settings/download` response.
5. **Second 401.** Answers the platform's own code and message when its envelope carried them.

## Files changed

- `internal/platform/lookup.go`: `Accounts` returns a `Page` with the total; the protocol filter; the second-401 answer; the token dropped by the handlers.
- `internal/api/platform_lookup_api.go`: the route, the `protocol` parsing, the `{suggestions, total}` answer.
- `internal/api/platform_connections_api.go`: `dropPlatformToken` on create, replace and delete.
- `internal/api/platform_lookup_api_test.go` and `platform_lookup_cache_test.go` (new): the stub accounts server and the lookup tests.
- `internal/api/pools_api.go`, `server.go`: the route and the injectable lookup client (`PlatformHTTP`).
- `internal/api/openapi.yaml`: the lookup path, the `protocol` parameter, the `{suggestions, total}` answer and the `LookupSuggestion` schema.
- `openspec/changes/platform-account-lookup/tasks.md`: 3.1 to 3.5 ticked.

## Commands and real output

- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./internal/api/ -run 'Lookup|ALookup|A401|ASecond401|A404|APassword|AViewer|TheLookup|OpenAPIMatchesRouter|Edit|Delete|Invalidating|TwoLookups|RefreshMargin|Protocol|PlatformStatus|Configuration|Second401' -count=1 -v`: every lookup, token, protocol, status and download test `--- PASS`, and `ok ... internal/api`.
- `gofmt -l internal/api internal/platform`: empty.
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./...`: `build ok`
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./...`: `vet ok`
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./... -count=1`: `Go test: 2237 passed in 37 packages`
- `openspec validate --all --strict`: `Totals: 52 passed, 0 failed (52 items)`

## Not checked

- **The live platform.** Every test runs against a stub accounts server.
- **Concurrent lookups** racing on one connection's token. The library serialises its cache with a mutex; no test races it.
- **The pipeline.** Not awaited when this body was written; it runs on push.

Closes #266
Refs #260

title: platform: map a connection row onto the library's appcontext (#264)
description:
## What and why

Maps a `platform_connection` row onto the `appcontext.ApplicationContextData` that the library's token call reads (task 1.3, design D5). The token host is the library's, derived from the context: this package builds the context from the base URL and asserts what the library derives from it.

The mapping (`internal/platform/appcontext.go`, `AppContextOf(id, baseURL)`):
- **scheme**: the base URL's scheme (`http` or `https`).
- **domain**: the host with a leading `api.` label removed. A host without that label keeps all of it, so a bare host is never given a label it does not have.
- **port**: the port when the URL names one, else 0.
- **separator**: `.`.
- **context id**: the connection's id. The library keys its token cache on it, so one token lives per connection.

A URL the context cannot express is refused with an `UnmappableURLError` naming the URL: an IP address (no domain to derive an accounts host from), a path, a user name, a query or fragment, an empty host, an `api.` label with nothing after it, a non-http scheme, and a port that is not 1 to 65535.

## What the tests assert

The library builds the token URL inside `GetTokenForCredentials` and does not export it. The test calls that function with `http.DefaultTransport` swapped for a transport that records the request and fails it, so no token is fetched and the URL asserted is the one the library derives:

| case | base URL | token URL the library derives |
|---|---|---|
| `api host` | `https://api.acme.com` | `https://accounts.acme.com/oauth2/access-token` |
| `bare host with a port` | `https://acme.com:8081` | `https://accounts.acme.com:8081/oauth2/access-token` |
| `api host with a port` | `https://api.acme.com:8081` | `https://accounts.acme.com:8081/oauth2/access-token` |

Also tested: a bare host keeps its domain and has no port (`TestABareHostIsNotGivenAnInventedLabel`), a trailing slash is no path (`TestATrailingSlashIsNoPath`), and eight refused URLs, each refusal naming its URL.

## Files changed

- `internal/platform/appcontext.go` (new): the mapping and `UnmappableURLError`.
- `internal/platform/appcontext_test.go` (new): the three table cases, the refusals, and the bare-host and trailing-slash tests.
- `go.mod`, `go.sum`: `go mod tidy`. The library is now a direct import, so its requirement loses the `// indirect` marker. `alldroll/cdb` (the `appcontext` package's dependency) and `golang.org/x/oauth2` (`clientsecretutil`'s) are added as indirect.
- `openspec/changes/platform-account-lookup/tasks.md`: task 1.3 ticked.

## Commands and real output

- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./internal/platform/ -count=1 -v`: `--- PASS` for `TestTheTokenURLTheLibraryDerives` with subtests `api_host`, `bare_host_with_a_port` and `api_host_with_a_port`; `TestABareHostIsNotGivenAnInventedLabel`; `TestAURLTheContextCannotExpressIsRefused` with its eight subtests; `TestATrailingSlashIsNoPath`. Result: `ok ... internal/platform`.
- `gofmt -l internal/platform`: empty.
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./...`: `build ok`
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./...`: `vet ok`
- `CGO_ENABLED=0 go test ./... -count=1`: `Go test: 2216 passed in 37 packages`
- `openspec validate --all --strict`: `Totals: 52 passed, 0 failed (52 items)`

## Not checked

- **The token call itself** is out of scope (a later task). This MR asserts the URL only.
- **The live accounts host.** The staging check in task 1.1 confirms `accounts-stg` answers the token path; this test does not contact a server.
- **The MR pipeline** was not awaited; it runs on push.

Closes #264
Refs #260

title: web: the Platform connections tab in Pools (#265)
description:
## What and why

The Pools screen gains a **Platform connections** tab, beside Numbering plan, Business & Sender ID pools, Content pools, Connections and MSISDN pools. It is the editor surface for the platform connections that the account lookup (task 3.x) fills accounts from. Every mutation goes through the routes that task 2.4 landed: `GET/POST /api/pools/platform-connections` and `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/pools/platform-connections/:id`.

- **List:** name, base URL, client id, and the secret's state: `Set`, `Set, stored unencrypted` (the connection was saved with no `auth.jwt-secret`, so the read reports `secretScheme: plain`), `Not set`, or `Needs re-entry` (the current key cannot open it), shown in the danger colour.
- **Row menu:** `View` for every role; `Edit` and `Delete` for an editor. A viewer sees the list and the read-only dialog, and no `New connection` button.
- **Secret field:** a password field, empty on open, never filled from the server. An empty value on save keeps the stored secret, so the body leaves `clientSecret` out. A typed secret is sent once. The dialog closes on save, so the typed value leaves the DOM with it.
- **Delete:** confirm first, as the other tabs do.

The tab is not the same as the existing **Connections** tab, which lists endpoints. The code and the labels keep the two apart.

## Files changed

- `web/src/pages/PoolsPage.tsx`: the sixth tab, `platform`.
- `web/src/pages/pools/api.ts`: `PlatformConnection`, `PlatformConnectionWrite`, and the four request functions, appended to the module that owns the request helpers.
- `web/src/pages/pools/PlatformConnectionsTab.tsx` (new): the list, the row menu, the delete confirmation.
- `web/src/pages/pools/PlatformConnectionDialog.tsx` (new): the add, edit and view dialog, with base-URL validation.
- `web/src/pages/__tests__/PlatformConnectionsTab.test.tsx` (new): seven tests.
- `web/src/pages/__tests__/PoolsPage.test.tsx`: the tab list now expects six tabs.
- `openspec/changes/platform-account-lookup/tasks.md`: task 4.1 ticked.

## Commands and real output

- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, no output).
- `npx vitest run src/pages/__tests__/PlatformConnectionsTab.test.tsx src/pages/__tests__/PoolsPage.test.tsx`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 69 passed (69)`.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0, `✖ 1 problem (0 errors, 1 warning)`. The warning is `react-hooks/incompatible-library` in `src/components/grid/DataGrid.tsx`, which this MR does not touch.
- `npm test -- --run`: exit 0, `Test Files 115 passed (115)`, `Tests 1758 passed | 1 expected fail (1759)`.
- `npm run build`: exit 0, `✓ built in 4.20s`.
- `openspec validate --all --strict`: `Totals: 52 passed, 0 failed (52 items)`.
- No Go file changed, so the Go gates are not part of this MR.

## Not checked, and deviations

- **`used-by` is not shown.** The brief lists a used-by column. The platform-connections API has no such field, and the `ui-pools` spec does not ask for one. The column is left out rather than faked.
- **`View` is added.** The spec's row menu says View, and the brief's acceptance does not mention it. The dialog is read-only for a viewer.
- **Acceptance evidence.** The brief asks that `an editor replaces its secret` and `deletes it` be shown. The tests cover the PUT with a typed secret, the PUT without one, and the DELETE request. The editor's add is covered too. The tests do not run against a live server.
- **Manual.** `web/src/content/manual/13-pools.md` is not updated for the new tab. Per the owner's rule, a manual sentence that becomes wrong goes to the owner's sweep.
- **Browser check.** Not run. The tests use jsdom, not a browser, so the layout of the dialog and the grid is unverified on screen.

Closes #265
Refs #260
